tool_arguments.summary: The root cause of the issue is in the `get_index_text` method of the `PyMethod` class. Specifically, when the `:property:` option is used, the method incorrectly adds parentheses to the index entry. The expected behavior is that the index entry for a property should not have parentheses. To fix this, the line in the `get_index_text` method that returns the index text for a property should be changed from `return _('%s() (%s property)') % (methname, clsname)` to `return _('%s (%s property)') % (methname, clsname)`. This will ensure that the index entry for properties does not include parentheses.
